title: Sign Language Video Synthesis via Loss-Guided Multi-Expert GANs
abstract: arXiv:2608.13368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This preliminary technical report presents a framework for sign language video synthesis using a loss-guided multi-expert Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to enhance communication for individuals with hearing impairments. Three specialized discriminators -- global, hand, and head -- each guide a corresponding expert branch in the generator toward a distinct visual region, enabling implicit feature specialization without explicit diversity losses. To stabilize this multi-discriminator system, whose early-phase training otherwise exhibits chaotic dynamics, we introduce a United Loss consensus mechanism that regularizes each discriminator toward the ensemble average at a 10% weight. Each branch further adopts a dual-pathway convolutional-transformer design with learnable AdaptiveFeatureFusion, balancing the stability of convolutions against the detail of windowed self-attention. The generator is trained using an alternating three-mode

translated_title: 基于损失引导的多专家生成对抗网络的符号语言视频合成
translated_abstract: 本初步技术报告提出了一种使用损失引导的多专家生成对抗网络（GAN）的符号语言视频合成框架，旨在增强听力障碍个体的沟通能力。三个专门的判别器——全局、手部和头部——分别引导生成器中对应的专家分支关注不同的视觉区域，从而在没有显式多样性损失的情况下实现隐式特征专业化。为了稳定这种多判别器系统（其早期训练阶段表现出混沌动态），我们引入了一种联合损失共识机制，以10%的权重将每个判别器向集成平均值正则化。每个分支进一步采用具有可学习自适应特征融合（AdaptiveFeatureFusion）的双路径卷积-变压器设计，平衡卷积的稳定性与窗口自注意力的细节性。生成器通过交替三模式进行训练。
tldr: 本文提出了一种损失引导的多专家GAN框架，通过全局、手部和头部三个判别器分别引导生成器分支，并引入联合损失共识机制稳定训练，实现了符号语言视频的高效合成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a loss-guided multi-expert GAN framework where global, hand, and head discriminators guide generator branches separately, with a United Loss consensus mechanism to stabilize training, enabling efficient sign language video synthesis.
